_comment: PLACEHOLDER detection-probability table for env v2 (plan sections 7.1 and 10.3).
pd[level][landcover][canopy] with level 0 = low (23 m, 1 cell footprint) and
landcover: 0 water, 1 grass, 2 forest, 3 cropland, 4 built.
canopy: 0 none, 1 sparse, 2 dense, 3 tall (tall forest and buildings).
These numbers are hand-set, NOT measured. The M1 detector gate measures recall
per (level, land cover, canopy) on Isaac renders and replaces this file.
If the env was trained with an older table, evaluate with the measured one
(plan section 10.3); retraining is needed only if the Tier 0 ranking changes.
